description_en: Imports a portable template in JSON format and creates a new template, regardless of whether a template with the same name exists
description_zh: 有效成员导入可移植模板 JSON 并创建新模板；无论名称是否相同都新建
name: ImportWorkflowTemplate

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The portable template in JSON format. The stepId and sortOrder fields can be omitted
parameters.help_zh: 可移植模板 JSON（stepId/sortOrder 可省略）
parameters.name: template

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

createdByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

description.example: 处理客户投诉的标准流程

edges.description_en: The node dependency edges. Each item contains from and to fields that reference stable step IDs. An explicit empty array indicates no dependencies
edges.description_zh: 节点依赖边；每项包含from/to，引用稳定stepId；显式空数组表示没有依赖

items.description_en: A node dependency edge. The from field specifies the step ID of the predecessor node, and the to field specifies the step ID of the successor node
items.description_zh: 一条节点依赖边，from为前置节点stepId，to为后置节点stepId

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current effective version number of the template. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists and the template cannot be used for work items. This field is empty because an import always creates a v1 draft
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 模板当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿、不可用于工作项（导入固定创建 v1 草稿，本字段为空）

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The modification time in ISO 8601 format

layout.description_en: The optional canvas layout, indexed by step ID. This field only affects the display and does not determine dependencies
layout.description_zh: 可选画布布局，按stepId索引；只影响展示，不决定依赖

schemaVersion.description_en: The schema version of the template. The current value is 2, which is independent of the business version vN
schemaVersion.description_zh: 模板结构版本，当前为2，与业务版本vN独立

ownerAgentName.description_en: The name of the agent owner

ownerType.description_en:
The owner type. Valid values:

USER: User. This is the default value.

APP: App
ownerType.description_zh:
owner类型。

USER：用户类型，默认值

APP：App类型

ownerUserId.description_en: The user ID of the employee executor

reviewOutput.description_en: Specifies whether to manually review the output. By default, this feature is disabled. It can be enabled only for digital employees. Review to-do items are automatically sent to the person in charge
reviewOutput.description_zh: 是否人工审核产出物，默认关闭；仅数字员工可开启，审核待办自动发负责人

reviewerUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs for the reviewers. This field is valid only for digital employee executor steps and is always empty for member executor steps
reviewerUserIds.description_zh: 负责人用户ID列表；仅数字员工执行人步骤有效，成员执行人步骤恒为空

items.description_en: The list of user IDs for the reviewers. This field is valid only for digital employee executor steps and is always empty for member executor steps
items.description_zh: 负责人用户ID列表；仅数字员工执行人步骤有效，成员执行人步骤恒为空

specification.description_en: The processing instructions for the step
specification.example: 收集客户信息，交给负责人审核

specificationJson.description_en: The ordered array of segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. The reference identities and order are preserved
specificationJson.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

items.description_en: The ordered array of segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. The reference identities and order are preserved
items.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

version.description_en: The version number generated by this import
version.description_zh: 本次导入生成的版本号

versionStatus.description_en: The version status. Valid values: DRAFT and SUBMITTED. The value is fixed to DRAFT for imported templates
versionStatus.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交；导入固定为 DRAFT
